en.title: MERGE CARD — merge PR #287: a round refused only for its report keeps its work
en.explanation: The review approved T-304. CI and the six gates are green on this head.

intent.text: The class line accepts detail between the numbers.
A round refused only for its report keeps its code.
The next round fixes only the report.
A launch never wipes kept work, even with a pull request.

why.text: T-303 lost a 49-minute round to one report line.
The next launch deleted the code when the task had a pull request.

done.text: Intent 1: a test shows a class line with detail passes.
Intent 2: a test shows a report-only refusal keeps the code.
Intent 3: a test shows a code change in the report round is refused.
Intent 4: a test shows kept work survives a launch with a pull request.

en.before: A round refused only for its report can lose all of its code at the next launch.
en.after: The code stays, and the next round fixes only the report.

how.text: A small record notes the refused round, and the next launch keeps that work when the pin and head match.

change_table.text: A report-only refusal keeps the code.

A.pros: A report mistake no longer costs a full round.
A.cons: A wrong record keeps old work until the pin or head changes.

B.cons: A report mistake can still delete a round.

C.cons: A change needs a new review, CI and six gates.

questions.text: Do you approve the merge of #287?

glossary.text: A fail-first test fails on the old code and passes on the new code.
A gate is one automatic check that a pull request must pass before a merge card appears.
A pin is a frozen copy of an approved spec that a task uses until the captain approves a change.
A round is one worker run or one reviewer run on a task.
The scope is the list of file patterns that a task may change.
The six gates are branch, rebase, scope, fail-first, CI and approval.

zh-TW.title: 【合併卡】合併 PR #287：只有報告不合格的一輪會保留工作
zh-TW.explanation: 審查通過 T-304。這個 head 的 CI 和六道 gate 都是綠的。

intent.text: class 行的數字之間可以加說明。
只有報告不合格的一輪，code 會保留。
有 PR 時，啟動也不會清掉保留的工作。

why.text: T-303 因一行報告丟了 49 分鐘的一輪。
任務已有 PR 時，下次啟動會刪掉 code。

done.text: 意圖 1：測試證明帶說明的 class 行能通過。
意圖 2：測試證明只有報告不合格時 code 保留。
意圖 3：測試證明修報告的輪改了 code 就退回。
意圖 4：測試證明有 PR 時保留的工作還在。

zh-TW.before: 只有報告不合格的一輪，下次啟動時會丟掉全部 code。
zh-TW.after: code 保留，下一輪只修報告。
zh-TW.outcome: 選 A 只合併 PR #287。

how.text: 一筆小紀錄記下退件的輪；pin 和 head 相符時，下次啟動保留該工作。

change_table.text: 只有報告不合格時 code 保留。

A.pros: 報告寫錯不再浪費一整輪。
A.cons: 紀錄出錯時舊工作會留到 pin 或 head 改變。

B.cons: 報告寫錯仍會刪掉一輪。

C.cons: 修改後要重新審查、跑 CI 和六道 gate。

glossary.text: 先失敗測試在舊程式上失敗，在新程式上通過。
關卡是合併卡出現前，PR 必須通過的一項自動檢查。
固定版本是已核准規格的凍結副本，任務用它直到船長核准修改。
輪次是工人或審查者在一個任務上的一次執行。
範圍是任務可以修改的檔案模式清單。
六關是分支、重定基底、範圍、先失敗測試、CI 和核准。
